verdict.rationale: ChatGPT's own docs say plugins can connect it to work tools such as Google Drive and SharePoint, which covers the cloud-drive part of the story. Email is only implied: Gmail appears as an event trigger for scheduled tasks and email triage, not as a source searched in chat answers. Calendar is never mentioned. Missing for 10: any calendar connector, explicit documentation of email search and retrieval in answers, detail on how connected-drive content is searched and cited, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can connect my cloud drive, email, and calendar so the assistant can search and use them in answers

citations.quote: Plugins can connect ChatGPT to the tools and information you use for work, such as Google Drive, SharePoint, Salesforce, or Gong.
scheduled tasks can run when a supported Gmail, Slack, or GitHub event occurs
Use an event trigger to triage new email, summarize channel activity, or act on pull request feedback without polling on a fixed cadence.
